name: Smart grids, microgrids and virtual power plants
aliases: Smart grids, microgrids and virtual power plants
applications: microgrids at remote oil and gas sites
principle: Software and communications aggregate distributed solar, batteries, flexible loads and generators so they dispatch like one power plant and provide reserves within seconds to minutes. North American VPP capacity was estimated at 37.5 GW in 2025.
